Hi there care team,
The senior handler recorded a point about cabin readiness this week, and I wanted to pass it on

I appreciate the care shown across the Companion Animal Travel Desk, especially when the workload is steady and the details are easy to overlook. The review notes show that our strongest habit remains the same: check the pet area early, confirm the carrier is secure, and make sure the calm items are in place before handoff. Safety still takes priority over speed, and that approach reflects well on Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep the handover language brief and consistent, and make sure any concern is routed without delay. <<FACT F093>> If the matter needs transfer beyond the desk, please follow the normal escalation path and keep the written record clear. <<FACT F106>> I also ask that any checklist gap be noted in plain terms, since concise reporting helps the next colleague respond with confidence and kindness.

Thank you for the careful work you continue to do for travelers and their pets. Small habits protect the journey, and your steady attention makes a real difference for families and animals alike. Please continue to apply the same measured standard on every case, and support one another with the same calm tone that the desk is known for.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
